honestConclusion: 10 permanent permissions recognized (all granted with provenance; Level-C all refused). Across the 14 Level-B parents, 56 sub-work items PROCEED now (local/done/prep) and 14 stay reserved (human sign-off / external) — proving a gated parent never immobilizes its computable sub-work. Public research is read-only; the mandate is revocable; ODG checks it, the provider cannot widen it.
